newsitem.title: UK: HS straight-run fuel well supplied in NWE, LS dips.
newsitem.headline: HS straight-run fuel well supplied in NWE, LS dips.

text.p: High sulphur straight run fuel activity was quieter on Thursday after a spate of deals yesterday.
Dealers said up to five cargoes found homes on Wednesday with an E-4 finding a buyer today at the equivalent of the flat formula. M-100 was heard offered at around $122 cif NWE.

Low sulphur straight run was pegged weaker on the back of good supplies and easier crude. One seller conceeded interest was slow and had cut his offer to $145 ffob, but potential buyers saw the market $2 lower.
High sulphur fuel had dried up in the Med, traders said.
